name_english: Vibhūti Yoga (The Yoga of Divine Manifestations)
summary_short: Krishna reveals His divine glories and manifestations present throughout the universe.
summary_medium: Krishna explains His supreme position as the source of all creation and describes how His divine presence can be recognized in the most powerful, beautiful, and meaningful aspects of existence.
summary_detailed: Krishna explains His originless and supreme nature.
True wisdom leads to devotion and peace.
Divine manifestations are present in all realms.
Recognizing divinity brings humility and awe.
God is the essence of excellence everywhere.
what_you_learn: How to see divinity in everyday life.
